notes:
## 0.5.9

- Long dictations no longer show a rewrite warning when Groq is busy. Dicta sends fewer requests and quietly uses plain cleanup for any piece it cannot rewrite.

- Dark mode also applies to native controls in the tray menu, meeting indicator and call offer for Paper, Glass and Soft.

- Paper, Glass, Soft and Contrast handle long names, chips and app lists without overlapping controls. Icon buttons are centred, and Soft's activity tooltip stays attached to its bar.

- Dicta now has four themes: Paper, Glass, Soft and Contrast, and new installs start in Soft Light. Older configs without a theme use Soft Dark unless an appearance was saved; removed themes move to Soft, in Dark for Rail, Focus, Ledger, Nord and Terminal and Light for Classic and Mono.

- Settings tiles now run from most used to least: General, Dictation, Writing, Meetings, AI & privacy, then About & help.

- History deletion works again after an update install or Settings close fails. If pending deletes cannot finish at shutdown, a brief closing message says those rows will be kept; it closes on its own only when there are no recording-save warnings to acknowledge.
